latex_workbench.compile.warnings: A compiled PDF establishes a build result. Review its typesetting, references and scientific content separately.
latex_workbench.compile.failure: Unsafe output paths exit 2 with a diagnostic on stdout. A compiler failure exits nonzero and preserves its evidence without publishing a PDF.

capability_probe_matrix.backend: Local Full Python environment makes synthetic fixtures and probes registry entries whose smoke tier is none.

inputs.detail: Registry to select probe entries from.
Include maintainer entries. Specified maintainer commands get help-only probes.
Time limit for each child probe.

outputs.detail: Matrix CSV, child run details JSON and applicable probe artifacts.
Rows and counts by probe outcome.

capability_probe_matrix.warnings: Optional backends can be unavailable. A missing probe or guarded rejection has distinct evidence from a successful probe.
capability_probe_matrix.failure: An invalid registry, runtime or failing probe can exit 1. Unsafe output paths exit 2 with a diagnostic on stdout.

portable_smoke_test.backend: Local Core or Full Python environment runs representative commands on packaged and generated samples.

inputs.detail: Optional override for the packaged samples root.
Core or Full test selection. Full checks additional prerequisites and coverage.

outputs.detail: Derived workflow products and registry coverage evidence.
Profile, per-feature runs and enforced coverage.
Examples source and generated artifact records.

portable_smoke_test.warnings: A passing suite covers its declared profile and fixture set. Check the coverage report before making claims about optional workflows.
portable_smoke_test.failure: Failed features or missing required coverage exit 1. Overlap with the examples tree exits 2 with a diagnostic on stdout.

validate_skill_samples.backend: Dedicated Full Python environment for maintainer regression checks. Optional format-specific checks depend on the input samples and locally available tools.

inputs.detail: Explicit sample trees to inspect. Use copies for validation runs.
Maximum representative samples of each supported extension.
Quick adds common regressions and portable Core smoke. Deep also runs broader checks selected by sample format.
Explicit opt-in to supplementing Numbers samples from the user's system Numbers directory.

outputs.detail: JSON and Markdown validation reports, with generated workflow products in feature_runs/.
Structured outcome, sample errors, failed features and metrics.
Validation roots, parameters, and completed report records.

validate_skill_samples.warnings: Zero supported samples yields WARNING when the feature checks pass. Optional workflows are covered only when their checks ran.
validate_skill_samples.failure: Sample or feature failures exit 1 and retain reports. Missing or invalid roots can exit 1 before reports are written. Output paths overlapping a sample tree exit 2 with a diagnostic on stdout.

sync_public_surface_docs.backend: Local registry renderer and generated-section markers in the bundled skill documentation.

inputs.detail: Optional registry override.
Compare generated sections without updating the documents.

outputs.detail: Snapshot targets, drift and written targets. Without check, the generated sections can be rewritten.

sync_public_surface_docs.warnings: Use check mode for an audit. Sync mode updates the named documentation sections.
sync_public_surface_docs.failure: Drift in check mode exits 1. A rejected path overlap exits 2 with a diagnostic on stdout.

skill_surface_audit.backend: Local audit of the selected mother skill registry, snapshot documents and script references.

inputs.detail: Mother skill root to inspect.
Omit the generated-residue inventory for runs that deliberately produce temporary files.

outputs.detail: Registry statistics, snapshot drift, missing references and residue inventory.

skill_surface_audit.warnings: Unregistered scripts are listed as inventory. Review their intended scope before treating their presence as a defect.
skill_surface_audit.failure: An invalid root or high-severity finding can exit 1. A rejected output path can exit 2 with a diagnostic on stdout.

inspect_fits.backend: Core with Astropy and NumPy. PNG quicklook uses Matplotlib. The limited NumPy fallback inspects the primary image.

inputs.detail: Readable original or copied FITS file with one or more HDUs.
HDU name or zero-based index for preview and pixel lookup.
Preview region as x0,y0,width,height. Its origin is zero-based.
Zero-based x,y in the original image. A cube uses its first plane. Values retain the declared BUNIT where available.
Additional FITS keyword to retain. May be repeated.
Positive approximate sample size for image statistics.
Maximum table columns described per HDU.
Requires --preview. Retains a diagnostic and summary if the bounded quicklook is unavailable.
Use the limited primary-image reader. Full HDU, WCS and pixel lookup support require Astropy.

outputs.detail: HDU descriptions, sampled data statistics, headers and available WCS.
Display-only quicklook when the selected image can be rendered.
Input and completed output records and processing parameters.

inspect_fits.warnings: Unavailable bounded quicklooks and low finite-pixel coverage can produce WARNING with a retained summary.
inspect_fits.failure: Unavailable or unreadable input and invalid coordinates can exit 2 with a diagnostic summary when its destination is writable.

catalog_workbench.crossmatch-sky.backend: Core with Astropy, NumPy and SciPy for nearest-neighbour celestial matching.

inputs.detail: Left catalog with at least one row and separate RA and Dec columns.
Right catalog with the same coordinate frame and epoch as the left catalog. The guided form accepts text tables.
Optional reader format for the left catalog.
Optional reader format for the right catalog.
Name of the RA column in the left catalog.
Name of the left declination column.
Name of the RA column in the right catalog.
Name of the right declination column.
Angular unit for the left RA column.
Angular unit for the right RA column.
Angular unit for the left Dec column.
Angular unit for the right Dec column.
ICRS for both inputs.
Positive common epoch if supplied. Required by the guided form. Positions are used as supplied.
Finite positive search radius up to 648000 arcseconds.

outputs.detail: Nearest accepted right-side match per left row, with match_sep_arcsec. The guided form writes ECSV.
Input and match counts, mapping and angular separation QA.
Both catalog input records, completed outputs and matching parameters.

catalog_workbench.crossmatch-sky.warnings: Empty matches, a search radius above one degree, and repeated use of one right row can yield WARNING.
catalog_workbench.crossmatch-sky.failure: Invalid input, coordinate metadata, or an unwritable destination can exit 2. Output aliases of inputs are rejected on standard output before writing any files.

photometry_noise_budget.backend: Python numerical model. No catalog, aperture image or external detector backend is required.

inputs.detail: Common unit of source, sky and dark counts.
Finite non-negative net source signal within the aperture.
Finite non-negative background sky level.
Finite non-negative integrated dark contribution.
Positive detector gain when using ADU.

inputs.unit: electrons RMS per pixel per frame
inputs.detail: Finite non-negative read noise in either input count unit mode.
Positive effective aperture area. Fractional pixels are supported.
Positive effective background sample area for the background-estimation variance term.
Positive integer count of combined frames.

outputs.detail: Variance components in electrons squared, total noise in electrons and dimensionless SNR.
Legacy summary destination used when --summary-json is absent.
Noise budget, assumptions and QA in a readable report.
Parameter and output records for the completed calculation.

photometry_noise_budget.warnings: Omitting background estimation or producing zero variance can yield WARNING. SNR is null when total noise is zero.
photometry_noise_budget.failure: Invalid values or numerical overflow exit 2. The diagnostic retains empty measurements and the reason.

astrometry_net_workbench.verify-existing.backend: The Full profile provides the supported Astropy and plotting stack. Local verification uses the existing FITS WCS and does not call an astrometric solver.

inputs.detail: Readable FITS with an existing celestial WCS. Image data in the selected HDU enables visual QA.

outputs.detail: Contains existing_wcs_quicklook.png when the selected WCS has a renderable image plane.
Center and corner sky positions in degrees, optional offset in arcseconds, and WCS round-trip residuals in pixels.
Existing WCS verification, caveats and reported diagnostics.
FITS input and completed verification output records.

astrometry_net_workbench.verify-existing.warnings: Header-only WCS or failed inverse round trips can yield WARNING. The check measures internal consistency without an independent catalog accuracy estimate.
astrometry_net_workbench.verify-existing.failure: A missing or unreadable file or absent celestial WCS can exit 2 with a diagnostic and empty measurements.

sb2_double_gaussian_workbench.fit.backend: Dedicated datanalysis environment with NumPy, SciPy and Matplotlib. Fits two Gaussians per cross-correlation trace.

inputs.detail: One or more CCF tables with velocity_kms and ccf_value columns. Case and aperture metadata keep observations distinct.
Optional parsed FXCOR results for a loose comparison. May be repeated.
Override the case identifier for a set of orders belonging to the same observation.
Finite positive minimum accepted separation of the fitted components.

outputs.detail: Contains sb2_double_gaussian_orders.csv, summary.md and available PNG fit figures in figures/.
Per-order acceptance, velocities and uncertainties in km/s, and per-case component summaries.
CCF and optional FXCOR input records and completed output records.

sb2_double_gaussian_workbench.fit.warnings: Failed or rejected individual orders yield WARNING and retain their diagnostics. A rejected order contributes no fitted velocity to the accepted case summary.
sb2_double_gaussian_workbench.fit.failure: Invalid CCF or options can exit 2 before writing fit tables or figures. The summary retains input-validation issues where writable.

li6708_equivalent_width_workbench.measur.backend: Dedicated datanalysis environment with NumPy, Astropy and Matplotlib for local continuum fitting, integration and plotting.

inputs.detail: Spectrum in angstroms. ASCII uses wavelength and flux in the first two numeric columns.
Echelle aperture containing the line. Omitting it permits automatic order selection.
Rest wavelength around which to measure the line.
Label for the measurement and plot.
Optional target identifier.
Two endpoints of a continuum interval. May be repeated.
Two endpoints of the equivalent-width integral.
Polynomial degree for the local continuum.
Optional reference equivalent width supplied by the user.
Skip the window-perturbation grid. The grid uncertainty stays null and the noise proxy remains separate.

outputs.detail: Contains li6708_summary.csv, li6708_summary.md, the line plot and the default summary JSON on a completed measurement.
Equivalent width in angstroms and milliangstroms, integration settings, separate uncertainty diagnostics and QA. Overrides the default summary location.
Spectrum and completed output records with measurement parameters.

li6708_equivalent_width_workbench.measur.warnings: Review the continuum placement and sampling. The window-grid scatter and the random-like noise proxy measure different effects.
li6708_equivalent_width_workbench.measur.failure: Unsupported wavelength units or inadequate line or continuum data can exit 2 with diagnostic JSON and no completed measurement.

photometric_solution.backend: Core in the dedicated datanalysis environment. NumPy and pandas fit the model, with Astropy table support and Matplotlib for the residual plot.

inputs.detail: Standard-star table such as CSV, TSV, ECSV or FITS. Use one consistent magnitude system and passband per fit.
Instrumental magnitude column.
Catalog or standard magnitude column.
Airmass column for fitting extinction.
Color index column for the optional color term.
Positive uncertainty on the standard minus instrumental magnitude difference for weighted fitting.
Fit a linear color coefficient when the color column is supplied.

outputs.detail: Coefficients, method, uncertainties or null, residuals and QA.
Optional additional copy of the same summary.
Fitted coefficients with their units and uncertainties.
Per-standard fit diagnostics and residuals in mag.
Residual diagnostic plot.
Method, fit diagnostics and quality flags.
Input and completed output records for the solution.

photometric_solution.warnings: Sparse coverage, high residual scatter or uncertain coefficients can produce WARNING. The extinction sign follows the standard-minus-instrumental convention.
photometric_solution.failure: Unreadable, insufficient or rank-deficient standards can exit 2 with an empty coefficient set and a diagnostic.
